facts.fact: The Burundi report presents routine DHIS2 data from the national health information system (SNIS) for 2020-2025, with its annual data quality score rising from 67 to 91 and national reporting completeness at 96% in 2025.
The report gives national completeness of monthly facility reporting at 96% in 2025 and 84% of districts at 90% or more.
